summary: B-And-B was a British sitcom starring Bernard Braden, his wife Barbara Kelly and their daughter Kim Braden. The show was written by Michael Pertwee. It aired a pilot and one series in 1968.
one_line: B-And-B was a 1968 British sitcom written by Michael Pertwee and starring the Braden family.
key_facts: B-And-B starred Barbara Kelly, the wife of Bernard Braden.
B-And-B starred Kim Braden, the daughter of Bernard Braden and Barbara Kelly.
B-And-B was written by Michael Pertwee.
B-And-B aired for a pilot and one series.
